unit.why: This division is a compilation of quoted teachings on Birkat ha-Mazon and blessings, from Sefer ha-Hinukh, Toledot (attributed to the Maggid), Sha'ar ha-Gilgulim and Nahalat Azriel's acrostic of laws; it contains no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: continues the section on the topic of Birkat ha-Mazon from the previous division; ends with the closing formula for letter ב and the heading for letter ג (greatness of the tzaddikim)
